title: Keep worker-state backups on the active job generation
summary: Keep the worker-state backup synchronized with the successfully committed active job, retire stale backup generations when refresh cannot complete, and clear both durable copies together.
reason: Remediate P2 AUDIT-FIND-W01-026. A cleared Job A backup could survive into Job B and replace a corrupt Job B primary during restart recovery.
behavior_before: Atomic writes copied the previous primary into the backup before committing the new primary, clear removed only the primary, and backup refresh failure left any old backup in place. A prior job could therefore be restored as the current job.
behavior_after: Worker-state saves atomically commit the new primary before mirroring that exact generation to backup. A failed mirror retires the stale backup, and clear removes backup before primary so no prior job can survive a completed clear.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_network_worker_state.py: backup mirrors the current job generation after consecutive saves.
tests/python/desktop/test_network_worker_state.py: backup refresh failure retires the stale generation while preserving the committed primary.
tests/python/desktop/test_network_worker_state.py: clear retires both primary and backup.
tests/python/desktop/test_network_worker_state.py: Job A clear followed by Job B corruption recovers only Job B.
